description: This Java class defines ServiceArtifactInfo, which provides detailed analysis and metadata about a specific service in the Apache OFBiz framework. It includes methods to populate related entities, services, and ECA rules, as well as generating visual model representations.

classes.name: ServiceArtifactInfo
classes.description: Represents detailed metadata and analysis tools for a specific service within the OFBiz framework, including relationship mappings, dependency analysis, and diagram generation.

methods.name: populateAll
methods.description: Populates all related entities, services, and ECA rules associated with this service.

methods.name: populateUsedEntities
methods.description: Populates entities used by this service based on its implementation code or configuration.

methods.name: populateEntitiesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds entity references based on a set of entity names, validating existence.

methods.name: populateCalledServices
methods.description: Populates the services called by this service based on its implementation or configuration.

methods.name: populateServicesFromNameSet
methods.description: Adds service references based on a set of service names, validating existence.

methods.name: populateTriggeredServiceEcas
methods.description: Identifies ECA rules triggered by this service and maps their references.

methods.name: createEoModelMap
methods.description: Generates a map representing the entity-relationship diagram for visualization.

methods.name: writeServiceCallGraphEoModel
methods.description: Exports the service call relationships and ECA rules as an EO Model diagram for visualization.

methods.name: getModelService
methods.description: Returns the associated ModelService object.

methods.name: setDisplayPrefix
methods.description: Sets a display prefix for naming the service representation.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Returns the display name for this service, including prefix if set.

methods.name: getDisplayPrefixedName
methods.description: Returns the service name, possibly with a display prefix.

methods.name: getDisplayType
methods.description: Returns the display type identifier (fixed as 'Service').

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the artifact type ID for services.

methods.name: getUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for this service.

methods.name: getLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the service's definition location.

methods.name: getImplementationLocationURL
methods.description: Returns the URL for the actual code implementation location.

methods.name: getEntitiesUsedByService
methods.description: Returns entities involved with this service.

methods.name: getServicesCallingService
methods.description: Returns services that call this service.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByService
methods.description: Returns services called by this service.

methods.name: getServicesCalledByServiceEcas
methods.description: Placeholder for services called via ECA rules, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: getServiceEcaRulesTriggeredByService
methods.description: Returns ECA rules triggered by this service.

methods.name: getServicesCallingServiceByEcas
methods.description: Placeholder for services calling this service via ECA rules, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: getServiceEcaRulesCallingService
methods.description: Returns ECA rules where this service is called.

methods.name: getFormsCallingService
methods.description: Returns forms that invoke this service.

methods.name: getFormsBasedOnService
methods.description: Returns forms based on this service.

methods.name: getScreensCallingService
methods.description: Returns screens that invoke this service.

methods.name: getRequestsWithEventCallingService
methods.description: Returns requests that invoke this service.
